job: Show the data an agent returned as a table, with a JSON view and a cost line.
purpose: A result card under the prose of an answer: a title with a row count, a Table / JSON switch, the rows, and one mono line saying what the run cost. Copy and download act on the JSON and CSV. New rows rise in one after another.
useWhen: The agent's answer is rows of data the person may copy, export or inspect.
A run should state its cost next to its output.

avoidWhen.when: A static table of records that is not an agent output.
A single JSON value or request body.
A short fact answered in prose.

states.name: new rows
states.how: data-new on a row; the staggered rise

variants.useWhen: A cell holds an id, a path or a date; set in mono at a muted tone.
A cell holds a number; right-aligned in mono.

parts.role: The Table / JSON view switch and copy or download buttons.
Holds the table or the JSON tree.
The file name and the cost line.
